Let’s talk about reporting and analytics.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Experience" above "Evidence-based reporting that decision-m"; "Skills" above "End-to-end analytics, Microsoft Fabric f"; "Projects" above "From reporting pipelines to civic-tech b"; "Awards" above "Hackathon and competition wins."; "Education" above "Always mixing theory and practice."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: Fira Code, Geist Mono — e.g. "A", "V", "E", "R"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 14 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Experience", "Nov 2025 – Present", "Sep 2023 – Sep 2024", "Mar 2023 – Aug 2023").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): section#contact.rounded-3xl.border → linear-gradient(to right bottom, oklab(0.921998 -0.00000908971 0.0000215769 / 0.1) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 20 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.relative.h-[110px] → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | article.rounded-3xl.border → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | article.rounded-3xl.border → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 29 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 4 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4, 4, 4, 5 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 142 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 10 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The sheet dealt STIX Two Text and STIX Two Text, but the page renders ui-sans-serif, Geist Mono.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it has no size yet).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: The margins differ: 192px on the left, 225px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: The page has no visible h1.
findings.fix: Give the first screen a clear title in an h1 that says what this is (a name with what it does, the product with what it is for, the event with its date and place).

findings.message: 28% of the first screen is one empty block (600×600px at 0,120).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: 5 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Evidence-based reporting that decision-makers ca" → 3 lines (7 words, 30px); "End-to-end analytics, Microsoft Fabric first." → 3 lines (5 words, 30px); "D D I I G G I I T T A A L L E E X X C C E E L L " → 3 lines (34 words, 30px); "B B U U S S I I N N E E S S S S I I N N N N O O " → 3 lines (36 words, 30px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 24px from the left edge but only to 52px from the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: A 432px stretch at 9536px holds nothing.
findings.fix: Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.
